location_note: Specialist report; no map reference. Placed by the name Siloam / City of David (gazetteer 'siloam', Z4). Excavation report ATQ101-071s (read below) gives the location.
notes: Radiocarbon date of a charcoal fragment in the plaster (L108, B1028) of the plastered pool next to the wall damming the Siloam Pool. The pool is coded as the sample's context (choice C2); same feature as ATQ101-071s. Abutting fill: Iron Age IIB pottery only; 14C 2300 +/- 55 BP, 540-190 cal BCE (2 sigma), read by the author as a production age or terminus post quem.
